title: Extra long tension rod
text: Extra long tension rod. I need a quick, temporary fix for a window covering while I wait for my mini blinds to be replaced.  This worked perfectly and easily.  Super easy to twist and set.  Stays right where it's set.  The silver looks a bit like a brushed nickel.  It is metal, but lightweight.

product_metadata.title: Umbra Chroma Tension Rod – Adjustable Tension Curtain Rod for Curtains and Sheer Curtains, 24 to 36 Inches, Auburn Bronze
features: HANG CURTAINS, NO DRILLING OR HOLES REQUIRED: The Chroma tension rod offers a contemporary solution for hanging drapes and curtains without the need for tools or drilling holes into trim or walls
DURABLE, STURDY CURTAIN RODS: Made of high-quality metal, Chroma supports light to medium-weight curtains and sheer curtains with a max weight of 15lbs.
EASY TO SET UP & MOVE: Chroma mounts inside your window frame in seconds using tension to stay in place. Taking them down and moving them to another window is just as easy

MODERN VERSATILE DESIGN: Designed by Luciano Lorenzatti for Umbra, this versatile tension curtain rod features an attractive modern look that is suitable for bedrooms, living rooms, dining rooms, kitchens, offices or studios

SATISFACTION GUARANTEED OR YOUR MONEY BACK: Umbra is committed to the highest levels of quality and excellence and stand behind every product we make. We know you’re going to love your purchase but if you’re not completely thrilled for any reason (or even no reason at all), simply contact us within 30 days of receiving your order and we’ll happily resolve the matter or issue a full refund
description: Ever wish you could hang curtains or drapes without any hassle, drilling or damage to your walls?

The Chroma Tension Rod by Umbra is a 7/8-inch diameter extendable tension rod that was designed to fit a variety of window sizes. Chroma mounts inside your window frame (without the need for mounting hardware or drilling) and uses tension to stay in place and support your curtains or sheer curtains.
Chroma is available in a variety of sizes to ensure a perfect fit in almost any window. It also comes in several colors; so finding the right match for your décor is easy.
A global product design company providing original, modern, casual and functional design for the home.
